steps.text: 22 Years Ago
3:09 P.M. \ Clear
Central Sargon, Ibut Region, Desert Outskirts

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Are... Are we there yet? How far away is it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you're tired, we can stop here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Drop the tough act.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It has been 7 hours and 14 minutes since our transport was wrecked in the ambush. Considering your physique and age, you've held up pretty well.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: No need...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Let's... keep going. We need to get out of here as soon as we can...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Where are we...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The nearest town to where we are heading. More accurately, it's a settlement formed of several towns that had been drifting in the desert with their hauling equipment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At the same time, this place covers a large swath of Sargon's no man's land, more than anywhere else. This is the way out for illegal immigrants, bounty hunters, and Messengers.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Why aren't we going to Minos?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I'm... I'm still not sure I can trust you any more than those mercenaries... What makes you different?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The difference is that you are alive.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You already have our next steps figured out, don't you...? What are we doing now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll look for someone trustworthy to take us out of Ibut. Not legally, of course.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Where are we going after that? Leithanien? Bolívar?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Before I give you an answer, you must understand that, whatever your choice, it doesn't change the fact you are running away from your problems.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have no way to survive, nowhere to go, and nowhere to run.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you prepared to accept the fact that your old life has already shattered to pieces? Do you understand it? Are you sure you are not just in a daze from this sudden turn of events?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Stop acting so high and mighty...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If anger gives you a clearer head.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will be going further north. Far away enough for you to leave everything in Columbia and Sargon behind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have to say. You've done very well.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Are you mocking me...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Much of what you do is rife with immaturity, and you let your emotions get the better of you. If you were a little older, I would indeed make a mockery of you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's go. We need to find someone to introduce us to the black market here.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Where do we find someone like that?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't know yet...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Hmph, so there's stuff you don't know?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't deny it, but we'll find them very soon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you understand what 'The Land of Reefsteep' means and stands for, you won't have any trouble finding their survivors in the crowds and markets here. They will always help their fellow countrymen. All we have to do is make them believe that's who we are.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Uh... What's that you're holding... Sargon coins?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What can you even do with a few coins...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You'll know soon enough.

steps.name: Sargon Townsfolk?
steps.text: (Sargonian) Get lost, Columbian...!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Huh? Enem—?!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Hiss)

steps.name: Sargon Townsfolk?
steps.text: Arghhh—Ahhhh—Monster! Where did it come from—?!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Thrusts)

steps.name: Sargon Townsfolk?
steps.text: Gah... Dammit... Why...?! I can't hurt it...!

steps.name: Passerby Sargon Townsfolk
steps.text: What's going on?! Ahhh—A monster! A monster's here to kill us!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: That's a huge crowd... Hey, what's going on? Who's this guy?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A bounty hunter from Vouivre... Looks like they're expanding their search area.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Quick. Follow me.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Uh, wait—

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: We came all the way here, but anyone walking down the street could still be a hitman. What's the point of coming—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's exactly why you need to pick up the pace.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What I'm saying is you haven't solved anything, Adviser Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: These outfits make us stand out, don't they...?

steps.name: Peddling Voices
steps.text: (Sargonian) This is just a can of vegetables. Why is it so expensive?

steps.name: Peddling Voices
steps.text: (Sargonian) Our rugs are famous far and wide—Something wrong with our quality? Impossible!

steps.name: Peddling Voices
steps.text: (Sargonian) Genuine top-grade earthenware jugs once used by the Lord Ameer—Sixty? Down from sixty thousand? Whatever, sold!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: There's a lot of people here... Is this where the market is?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: ...? Why'd you stop—Mm?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Being superstitious this time...?

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Ah... How rare... It has been a long time since an outsider paid Old Isin a visit.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Do you wish to take a peek at what destiny has laid out before you, or perhaps you are searching for a particular piece of gravel in this sandstorm?

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Am I correct to assume you are responsible for the ruckus earlier?

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Old Isin can tell, dear traveler. You are in a hurry, and trouble follows in your footsteps... Old Isin simply hopes this won't lead to any more trouble for Sargon...

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: You are not from Sargon, no, but you carry a great burden...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What is he mumbling to himself about...? Let's not waste any more time on him, Kal'tsit. They'll catch up!

steps.name: Sargon Villager
steps.text: (Sargonian) You fraud! What are you still doing here?! Scram!

steps.name: Sargon Villager
steps.text: (Sargonian) You're mucking up our turf! Enough with your tricks! No one here's going to fall for that!

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) Oh, right, of course. Don't be so violent now... Old Isin will leave. Old Isin is leaving.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) Is your master doing well? Has she taken Old Isin's advice and pulled out of that deal yet? It will mean nothing but trouble for her.

steps.name: Sargon Villager
steps.text: (Sargonian) My master? The chief would never listen to you jabbering types in the first place. If any lunatic in town could just waltz in and tell us how to do business, we might as well set up a suggestion box!

steps.name: Sargon Villager
steps.text: (Sargonian) Enough chit-chat! Get out of here!

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Hmm!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you okay...?

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Agh... It hurts... Please, don't worry. Old Isin's gotten used to it long ago...

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Old Isin cannot save them. Old Isin cannot get them to come around... Old Isin can do nothing but watch as they draw ever closer to their destruction day after day.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Please accept Old Isin's apologies, but as you can see, Old Isin is being thrown out of this place. If there is anywhere willing to take in poor Old Isin, that's where Old Isin will go.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) Wait.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) Old Isin mustn't... Old Isin mustn't...

steps.name: Sargon Villager
steps.text: (Sargonian) Stay out of this. If he doesn't leave, it's gonna be on our heads. Just let him go!

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) She's right. Her master calls the shots here, and she mustn't be trifled with. Let Old Isin leave, kind traveler. Let Old Isin return to his ice-cold home.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Why are we wasting our time here on this old conman again?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At least you can tell he's old.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But you can't imagine how old he is.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: The sun has set long ago, traveler. You are in a hurry, and there are dangers abound. Why waste your time here with Old Isin?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) As time goes by, even the greatest Padishah will one day be lost to the sands. His achievements will at that point crumble, and his subjects will scatter across the lands.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) From the way you are dressed, you don't seem to be Sargonian. Is this perhaps the beginning to a narrative poem? Old Isin is far too old. Old Isin has long forgotten the appeal of poetry.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) But his servants remain ever dedicated to their duties. They guard the unpopulated desert until a new civilization is ready to stand atop its sands, until the time a new Padishah arrives with the will of Sargon to rebuild those lands.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) Ah, similar stories happen in all countries in the world time and again.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Catastrophes, diseases, war... There are a great many ways a city can meet its end... and to find itself conquered by a new, spirited ruler, thereby repeating the cycle once again.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: (What are they saying... Is this how Sargonian sounds?)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) 150 years ago, before these golden sands were named Ibut, there stood a magnificent city here. Do you remember anything of it?

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) Of course... Old Isin remembers. The city that disappeared in those great winds.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) The Padishah at the time gave these lands brimming with sand a name that might seem unfitting for a place in Sargon.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: ...Reefsteep...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) The only thing that remains of it is its name, passed down from one generation to the next, with none of them ever laying their eyes on its lush oases.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) Are you its gatekeeper, then?

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Is there anything Old Isin can do for you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We want to escape Sargon, leaving no tracks.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Ah... Old Isin understands. Whose attention are you trying to avoid?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not even Padishah can know of our whereabouts.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please call me Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: Kal'tsit... Lady Kal'tsit... As Old Isin gazed upon the sunrise this morning, Old Isin slipped back into my dreams in a trance. In Old Isin's dreams, Old Isin was told there would be a visitor who would revel in these secrets of antiquity with us.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: You came early. The price is a single gold coin, my fair lady.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You deserve it.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: (Just that much...?)

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: No, no... Not yet. Please hold on to it, my lady.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: This is a price that you will pay—22 years later. Remember this promise well, for it is worth far more than this gold coin.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sargonian) You have lived in Sargon in its current form for the past hundred years. I suppose... not a single moment has gone by where you didn't look back and reminisce your homeland.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Sargonian) You are correct, my lady, but today is different.

steps.name: Mysterious Fortune Teller
steps.text: (Stranger Sargonian) You opened the door for us.
